{{Conjecture|legends}}
The '''military commander''' was a member of a [[Unidentified species (Unknown Regions)|species]] which had developed a primitive form of [[Realspace/Legends|space travel]]. At some point prior [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], he came into conflict with [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]], [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]]. The military commander had sculpted [[three warrior statues]] from wood and covered them with precious metals and gems. Thrawn&mdash;who learned about his enemies by studying works of their art&mdash;wanted these statues to gain insight into his enemy.
